page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Right margin: small marginal notes and a reference mark beside the text. Left margin: a column of printed marks (not text). Running head at top, page number at top right, gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: thiorum, quos exules fuga elapsi, precibus fatigarant, ductu Timoleontis heroïs optimi & felicissimi cum copiis non magnis istuc profecti, pene sine labore folio rursum dejectus, & Corinthum relegatus est,anno à morte patris xxv, qui fuit Olympiadis cix annus secundus, à reditu suo ab exilio quintus surgens: ludibrium fortunæ ac vulgi,& cum e Sicilia discederet navi impositus, & cum Corinthi appulit; ubi quod reliquum fuit infamis vitæ turpiter egit. Timoleon arce urbeque potitus libertatem civibus reddidit, vitia quædam ejus sustulit nimia popularitate periculosa: in Dioclis legibus interpretandis & elucidandis opera usus est Cephali Corinthii, & Dionysii eadem civitate oriundi: magistratum novum annuum instituit summæ dignitatis, quem vocari voluit famulum Iovis Olympii, memoriam servaturum libertatis reparatæ, jussitque ejus nomine annum in actis signari, ut Athenis nomine archontis [illegible, ~2 letters]& Romæ consulum: quod institutum manfit in civitate Syracusana ad eam à [illegible, ~2 letters]Romanis occupatam per annos circiter cxxxi. Primus Iovis famulus suffragiis designatus traditur Callimedes vir inter suos honoratus. Ad hæc Timoleon, quod optatissimum civitati erat, à Dio-
[Marginal notes at the right edge: several small, partly illegible fragments; not legible letter by letter.]

page.notes: The left margin carries a column of small printed marks or ornaments, not words; they are not transcribed. The right margin notes near "in actis", "manfit" and "Romanis" are too small and blurred to read; only the fragments marked [illegible] are given. The word "ne" at the foot right is the catchword, completing "Dio-" as "Dionysio". The signature "i 4" is uncertain. The word "hæc" is read as printed with the ligature; a possible misreading. The running head is given with the u/v rule applied to capitals: SYRACUSANAE.
